dress_code.men: Kurta-pyjamas, dhotis, or formal shirts and trousers. Shorts and sleeveless shirts are prohibited inside the complex.
dress_code.women: Sarees, half-sarees, or salwar kameez are highly encouraged. Shorts, sleeveless, and tight-fitting clothes are prohibited.

dos: Do perform 11 pradakshinas (circumambulations) around the outer path to make your wish.
Do return to perform 108 pradakshinas barefoot once your wish is successfully fulfilled.
Do maintain silence, walk in an orderly line, and follow instructions from temple volunteers.
Do dress in traditional, modest Indian attire to respect the sanctity of the temple.
Do keep track of your pradakshinam counts using simple paper tallies or counters available outside.
donts: Don't offer money, gold, or gifts to the priests or temple workers. The temple has no hundi.
Don't carry mobile phones, smartwatches, cameras, or recording equipment inside the inner temple.
Don't wear footwear inside the designated outer boundary line of the temple gates.
Don't carry leather goods (wallets, belts, leather jackets, bags) into the temple premises.
Don't consume non-vegetarian food, alcohol, or smoke for 24 hours prior to your temple visit.
Don't throw away garbage or waste paper outside of designated trash bins.
electronic_ban: Don't carry mobile phones, smartwatches, cameras, or recording equipment inside the inner temple.
